notes.title: Version 0.8.1 Dev Vlog update
notes.content:
New demo update. New locomotive in the demo. There are planes added to the full version as well. Those are not playable yet. Bug fixes and quality of life improvements. I got rather drunk in this video. I really drank too much too quickly. Oh well. At least the demo works. 

Lots of quality of life improvements. The game is getting done. Hoping to have another update before the year is out. Or at the start of next year. I'm working on the game full time.

notes.title: Year end Dev Update
notes.content:
Progress on the game is still moving along. I have the trains, trucks, small planes and large planes in the game now. There is still more work to be done before the game goes into closed BETA. I'm hoping on having the game in closed BETA and sent off to the publisher some time in January. Aiming for release some time in the new year. 

New trailer and screen shots some time next month. There are 17 large planes in the game now. A good selection from all the decades. I may add more small planes and trains before release. 

The tileset will be redone before release. There is a whole lot of polish left to do. I am hoping the game will be in a playable state in a months time. With save games and a passenger system. 

Ships will be added after the BETA.

Trains, small planes, trucks and large planes are all just about finished up now. The trains where by far the most work.

Leave a comment if you have any questions. I'll try to respond to them all.

notes.title: Random dev update
notes.content:
Wrote some good code last night. The drag and drop trains and wagons code in Epic Trains 4 is better coded and has more functionality then what is in OpenTTD.  This is going to be a great game.

What is on the store page now is very basic. The game is barely in a functional state at this point. I'm hoping to have the trains finished up in the next few days and move on to the automobiles and planes. If I can do it those will be done by the end of next month and there will be version 2 of the trailer up on the store page for everyone to have a look at.

This is my 20'th game. I know game dev. 

Just giving a little update on how the game is going.
